title: See your approved terminology while you edit
summary: A term base panel in every memory-backed editor, step owners for Cosmos runs, and music and sound effect tracks on the Translate Video timeline.

items.title: See approved terminology while you edit.
items.body: A terminology panel shows the terms in your text and the full term base A to Z, with grammar and concept details. It works with Phrase memories and stays hidden for other providers.

children.body: Playground logs and playground text translation

items.title: Term hits are highlighted in Translate Video,
items.body: and forbidden terms are struck through.

items.title: Choose who owns each step when you start a run.
items.body: A new **Run settings** step in the run dialog has a searchable picker per step and can copy owners from the step above. Steps are listed in workflow order, matching the diagram beside them.

items.title: Owners are notified
items.body: in the app and by push when their step finishes and at approval gates.

items.title: Owners belong to the run.
items.body: They show on the run detail and can be changed mid-run, without touching the workflow.

items.title: Add music, sound effects and ambience to the timeline.
items.body: Audio tracks belong to the whole process rather than a transcript card, and are mixed into the export. The timeline has collapsible Video, Dialogue and Audio sections.

items.title: Upload or record a track.
items.body: Review it before adding it. The full take is always kept.

items.title: Trim by dragging an edge.
items.body: Times show milliseconds, and waveforms stay just as detailed when trimmed.

items.title: Mute is for preview only.
items.body: To silence a track in the export, set its volume to 0.

items.title: Speaker voice mapping redesigned.
items.body: A Speakers toolbar with select all and an "x of n assigned" count, and a Clone or Library choice per speaker that stays put when the selection changes. All speakers start unselected, and the video panel stays in view on narrow screens.

items.title: Subtitle translation has its own icon
items.body: in process tables, so it no longer looks like subtitle generation.

items.title: Edit Folder opened blank.
items.body: The dialog now shows the folder's details. The same fix applies to editing Memory categories and Prompt library categories.

items.title: Subtitle Translation cards opened the Video upload tab.
items.body: The cards on the dashboard and the Translate Video page now open the Subtitle tab, and it stays selected after a reload.

items.title: Transcript cards overlapped after changing page.
items.body: Cards now sit at their real height on every page, and filtered language and voice lists no longer keep the previous list's row sizes.

items.title: Verifying cards on one transcript page added them to another.
items.body: Each page now shows only its own cards.
